    Setting 8.4: local generators and endpoint chains of a ray table #

    set:projective-companion: A₀ = kP with its normed homogeneous ray basis; each local ring is R_x = k[q_x]/(q_x^{N_x}) with q_x a ray (or q_x = 0 when R_x = k), and by Lemma 3.1(3) the endpoint subbimodules of each Hom form a chain, each generated over one endpoint ring (lem:endpoint-chains). In ray terms:

    • q x is 0 or a nonidentity loop at x, and every loop at x is q x ^ j e_x;
    • for each ray r, every ray q^i r q^j equals q^i' r for all such, or r q^j' for all such (one-sided generation);
    • the rays of each Hom form a chain under s ∈ U(r).

    Sys bundles a ray table with this structure. Products are computed in the monoid with zero M P; we write ⌜r⌝ for a ray in it.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.RaySys.Sys (V R L : Type) [AddCommGroup L] :
    Type

    Setting 8.4 for a ray table.

    • P : Tab V R L
    • q : V → M self.P.toMult
    • q_cases (x : V) : self.q x = 0 ∨ ∃ (g : R), self.q x = self.P.rr g ∧ self.P.src g = x ∧ self.P.tgt g = x ∧ g ≠ self.P.e x
    • q_pow (r : R) : self.P.src r = self.P.tgt r → ∃ (j : ℕ), self.q (self.P.src r) ^ j * self.P.rr (self.P.e (self.P.src r)) = self.P.rr r
    • cyc (r : R) : (∀ (i j : ℕ), self.q (self.P.src r) ^ i * self.P.rr r * self.q (self.P.tgt r) ^ j ≠ 0 → ∃ (i' : ℕ), self.q (self.P.src r) ^ i * self.P.rr r * self.q (self.P.tgt r) ^ j = self.q (self.P.src r) ^ i' * self.P.rr r) ∨ ∀ (i j : ℕ), self.q (self.P.src r) ^ i * self.P.rr r * self.q (self.P.tgt r) ^ j ≠ 0 → ∃ (j' : ℕ), self.q (self.P.src r) ^ i * self.P.rr r * self.q (self.P.tgt r) ^ j = self.P.rr r * self.q (self.P.tgt r) ^ j'
    • chain (r s : R) : self.P.src r = self.P.src s → self.P.tgt r = self.P.tgt s → (∃ (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ), self.P.rr r = self.q (self.P.src r) ^ i * self.P.rr s * self.q (self.P.tgt r) ^ j) ∨ ∃ (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ), self.P.rr s = self.q (self.P.src r) ^ i * self.P.rr r * self.q (self.P.tgt r) ^ j
